findings.finding: Only 27% of the modeled 2a1 primary-vacancy rate has exclusive products; prompt Hplus58% and Oplus15% stay positive and unmapped. Hplus does not determine OH versus H+O neutral companions; Oplus does not determine H2 versus two H. Oxygen1a1 core and direct projectile double/triple channels remain unqualified.

findings.finding: Exact event conservation does not validate equal-energy primary/secondary sharing, ground states, isotropic breakup, fixed hole lines or a collapsed isolated-site cascade. The high-velocity matrix inferred using proton data is applied conditionally to electron BEB holes, not measured over every1..10keV electron energy. No proton collision rate was imported.
